review_description: RACQ solar were great to deal the whole way through the process.  they were responsive and Jade, the Project Manager, was very professional, proactive and nothing was an issue.

Initial quoting experience through RACQ solar was thorough and unhurried with plenty of conversation time with the representative to supply a system fitting for our needs.  Once the prospective install was approved by our energy supplier the install date was set without delay.  I was kept updated by RACQ/Gem Energy coordinator at every step, and any queries answered promptly.The install and subsequent grid connection itself went efficiently on time and without a hitch, under a very knowledgeable leader and friendly crew. Definitely five star service.  Highly recommended.Also, and importantly, we can be confident that RACQ/Gem Energy will still be in business into the future!
Everyone involved - from the quote, to the acceptance, to the details of what to expect, to the installation, were very helpful and professional.

We've just had a Sigenergy house battery installed through RACQ. The process was so easy it's hard to believe. Everything was taken care of. The communication was brilliant and kept us up to date every step of the way. Thanks to Jade, Eva, Mark and Gary from RACQ and a huge shout out to Scott and his crew from ECG Electrical that fitted the battery. A week in and we've not bought any power from the grid.We already had 17kw's of panels but at 3 cents per kwh feed in tariff and now buying during peak time at 40 cents per kwh we were still getting decent sized bills.

I submitted an enquiry through RACQ website and Mat has contacted me in no time. He was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions regarding the design and options for my new solar battery. The quote was straight forward and I had an opportunity to ask more questions as I did my own research on the hardware options. I felt well informed and comfortable when making final decision. Once I signed the contract I was provided with all documentation and options for installation. The installer visited the site prior to inspect and provide final installation quote. During this process my existing 6 years old inverter has been replaced for hybrid. The customer service emailed me all information prior. The installers arrived on time and told me the timelines and what will happen. They were on the site few hours and cleaned after themselves. They answered my questions, set me up on the app and gave a little demo.
We had solar panels installed just over 12 months ago, now we had a solar battery installed. Wonderful experience.

Being RACQ I expected them to act more ethical compared to all the other 'we're in you area' solar insallers.They give a quote with a good price over the phone and emails without even looking at the property, then they want a 30% deposit up front before they even look at the property.I managed to get the deposit down to $500.Then when they come to inspect the property I get a variation sent that is more than 10% of the total project cost. So their quoting process might work for standard installed, but be careful of the quote.Seems to be working ok so far, will see how it goes in summer.

We purchased a $27,000 solar PV system from RACQ only to find out that the system seriously underperforms by 25%+ less power generation than what was sold. RACQ have since admitted they miscalculated shade from trees surrounding our property. We're now taking them to court for misleading us as they will not remedy the issue, even after admitting that they stuffed up. Avoid RACQ Solar at all costs and if you are considering them because they're cheaper, be sure to check their proposed monthly power generation in detail before purchasing. They offer no support or solutions when things don't match what they design and sell. As a long-term RACQ customer, we expected better from RACQ and made the mistake of thinking RACQ was a reputable brand you could trust. Buyer beware!

From the initial chat, to post installation, all communication has been easy, concise, factual and forthcoming.I suggested what I'd like the most out of my system, and was able to get quotes with and without batteries, so multiple systems were quoted.They were able to supply the quality panels I wanted, and explain the differing specifications between inverters and batteries effectively.Installation went through very easily and I couldn't be happier.

We had a lot of quotes, but in the end we decided to go with RACQ. They were slightly dearer, but, right from the salesperson quote, we knew we were being looked after. Communication from our installer was fantastic, keeping us informed all the way. Installation team were absolutely brilliant,  Ashley and his team were professional, courteous and a pleasure to deal with. Ashley even checked in next day to make sure things were okay. Couldn't reccomend RACQ highly enough.

The quoting process was easy and the the employee knew his stuff and as not pushy.The installer was local, and arrived on time. They were polite and cleaned up after themselves.The installer took the time to talk us through the online app and checked in to see if we were happy with everything.As a long time member of RACQ I also received another discount on my solar quote which was a considerable amount saved.Could not be more happy with the whole process.

RACQ solar was excellent from start to finish.  Quote process was easy and the quoter (Javier) provided a number of alternate quotes on request based on different configurations. Quote was easy to understand. Install manager (Sophie) had to work hard due to many rain days but was very responsive and flexible to my needs. They also went the extra mile to ensure all applicable government rebates were applied.

Generally very happy with the entire process. We initially sought quotes from 3 installers through SolarQuotes but added RACQ after a neighbour's recommendation. RACQ were competitive but not quite leading on price only (several hundred $ off), but their reputation was our deciding factor. The onsite inspection and discussion was really helpful and minimal pressure, as was agreeing the quote and arranging the installation.We agreed the installation date, and the team turned up on time and got on with the job, and as a bonus either replaced or repaired some of my cracked roof tiles all as part of the process. With one of the installation days rained out the completion of the job had to wait until the following week, but again the team were on time and professional.Only places I'd look for an improvement would be a follow-up confirmation of the installation date a week prior to installation (I scheduled over a month out from paying the deposit), and advance notice of what the backup date is in case of rain delays, but these are both minor items. The system is working well, and we're very happy with the decision to go with RACQ.

Quoting process with the sale consultant was greatThe gents who installed the system where prompt and worked in well with us as we both work from homeCustomer service was great, with the wet weather we had to re-schedule and their team did what they could to mitigate any further delays (they still came out and did the switchboard upgrade on the day) couldn't have asked for a better service from the guys

RACQ contract electrician Bold were great.  Arrived on time with all the gear and 5 electricians.  Had the full install done in a day which was amazing.  Workmanship was neat and they cleaned up after the install.Dealing with RACQ Solar was easy; they were polite, knowledgeable and efficient.Great job all around.

I went through a multitude of providers in my research, covering the spectrum of cheapest, to most expensive. I was able to find a very comfortable solution, meeting both my specific requirements, and budget. The pre-purchase sales process was great, not pushy, but very helpful and informative. The installation went perfectly (besides a slight delay of a cyclone heh), the installation guys were really friendly and helpful. Communication has been brilliant, anytime I've had any questions or clarification it was very prompt, and I never felt out of the loop, or unsure of any details of my install. And post-install I have to say it's well exceeded my expectations of production output and efficiency. Very satisfied with the whole process now it's all finished, and I can stop paying insanely high power bills.

Once again Kristian, Sandler and Sophie gave absolutely fantastic customer service, was absolutely delighted to know that after RACQ took Gem energy on board they were still there from when we had Solar installed on our previous property.I cannot recommend either of these 3 team members more. If you need assistance with Solar these are the people to ask for, second time round and still can't fault them, if i ever need a Solar system again i wouldn't pick anyone else.

From my first enquiry , through to installation, the process was very professional, all our questions were answered , no big sales pitch just honest, informed customer service. The installation process was excellent, the team kept us informed as they needed to turn power off and checked every step of the way to ensure we were happy with the job. I can highly recommend RACQ solar.

They handled everything so well from first point of call to completed installation. The whole process was quick and painless. Highly recommended if you want a local professional comoany with backbone.

RACQ was easy to deal with start to finish. Was a close decision between racq and one of the companies supplied by solarquotes. However racq had an eofy sale which gave a more optimal solar system at a similar price.

My old solar system was 14 years old, so decided to get a Safety Inspection from RACQ Solar. I was expecting a doom and gloom report that my system was not performing and possibly dangerous and to recommend immediate replacement, obviously from RACQ Solar. Although not a qualified electrician I know my way around electrical systems.The RACQ electrician arrived at the agreed time and after an initial greet he explained exactly what the inspection would entail (I was impressed). The inspection took about an hour, and he produced a full report and explained the problem with the current system.  As I receive the Government Solar Rebate, he explained the benefits of replacing the system with current panels and inverter which are much more efficient than my current ones in regard to performance.I agreed to go ahead with the replacement which entailed complete removal of my old panels (20) and installation of the new panels (10) and inverter. The RACQ team arrived at the agreed time and the whole system was up and running that day.RACQ Solar highly recommended for Solar.

From initial enquiry to post installation I cannot fault RACQ Solar in Queensland.  All persons involved have been informative and positive.  The installation team Bold Electrical Group on the day were simply amazing in all aspects.  The customer service from quote through to post installation has been superb.  Highly recommended
The service has been very diligent and professional. Install for solar panels, inverter and battery was all done within 2 days. Very happy with the service to date.

The sales and quoting process was so  good it was a pleasure to deal with RACQ Solar. The installation was punctual and completed as advised. The installation team were so good and efficient. The customer service made the whole process so easy.Everything was organised for us including the connection and documentation.

I contacted a few providers for information with varied results.I read through a lot of information thanks to SolarquotesHowever on ringing RACQ Solar my concerns were laid to rest.Each step was explained efficiently and in a timely fashion. Questions answered without haste.The review of the site carried out with more explanations and contacts if help needed.The installer came to the property and surveyed the job which entailed removal of old system and installation of new.The day of installation was trouble free. Both installation and communication with the two men was excellent.They cleaned everything up and took away waste. Grid connection was completed.They setup the app for phone and showed how to monitor Kw usage and production.Throughout the process and still ongoing is the support from RACQ Solar.Even the form filling out and completion of paperwork was done for me.I am totally satisfied and confident that I could not have made a better decision.Thanks to all concerned.
Polite, punctual, good comms, great team, good price happy to negotiate, knowledgeable, friendly

RACQ (Leo) presented me with a quote and after a little negotiation I accepted the quote Leo was fantastic to work with in securing a value for money proposal. Leo handed over to Annalee who coordinated the decommissioning of the old solar system and the installation new solar system. The installation was not straight forward as I needed to replace some roof sheets after removal of solar hot water system. Annalee coordinated the work between the roofer and their installer and the replacement of the roof sheets and the decommissioning of the old solar system and the installation of the new solar system went without an issue. I am therefore very happy to recommend RACQ to anyone that is in the market for as solar system.
Excellent result for a very complicated installation with two phases of power, existing panels and a geni.  Poor guys did a great job working in torrential rain.

Leo was amazing at explaining everything and let the videos and reviews he sent through do the selling.  Darby has been a great install supervisor and michael and his team so professional with the install.  I would say, Gem under promise but over deliver.  Could not be happier.  $33,500 for a 13.2kw German system panels, 3 phase 10Kw inverter and a 22kw 3 phase zappi car charger
Sales quote was done from my home. The Installation was punctual. The whole process was done professionally.

Quoted for upgrade from 3 Kw to 6.6 Kw, no pressure on my requirements from sales, very helpful.Removed old system and delayed new install to repoint, replace and repaint tiled roof for 2 months.New system installed within 10 days, 6 hrs. later my first Wi-Fi interpretation available for mobile devices.Customer service thru their installation manager was very thorough.Grid connection thru existing 10-year-old meter, supplier will notify if this has to be replaced.Pics show 3 strings of 4,5 and 6 panels, 2 strings north facing at 22 degrees 1 string east facing at 2 degrees.Sungrow 5 Kw inverter at least half the size of old 3 Kw Sunnyboy.

I have just had my solar installed by RACQ following extensive research into providers available on the Sunshine Coast. The quote, follow up, site inspection (once home build was completed) and communication of the impending installation and follow up with Sophie McLennan was excellent as well as the promptness on the day of the guys installing the solar for me.  The installation went without any issues and I received detailed instruction on how to use and monitor my new system with the isolar app.  Would highly recommend RACQ solar for price, product quality, installation and after sales service.
All good. This was a good install. It all went well
Javier Borello Was helpful and informative even after the installation

RACQ Solar were amazing from start to finish - they were professional, knowledgeable and so easy to work with. Nothing was too much trouble and they ensured that the system works to capacity. Would definitely recommend them to friends and family.

RACQ offered a discount to members if they purchased their solar through Gem Energy. Gem's sales person came on site and was very clear in explaining their product. After getting all the quotes together and carefully comparing them it was apparent the Gem quote was better value for money, used a high standard of products and used LiFeP batteries, which my research indicated were a better and longer lasting technology than the LiIon ones from most other companies. We'll see haw they are going in 10 or 15 years time.Once the contract was signed we were appointed an Installation Manager who was true to her word, kept us up to date with every aspect of the preliminary site inspection, system design, installation, commissioning and handover. The weather (in South East Qld in February and March 2002) played havoc with the installation plans, but we were kept up to date at all times as things changed. Gem's local Sunshine Coast solar and electrical team were fantastic in all aspects of their work, and in the final instructions and hand over of the system.The also arranged for our grid supplier to make the necessary changes to our meters and  switch box.

Ongoing engagement with me during the process. No undue pressure or slagging off other businesses as part of the sales pitch. Put together a mix of components that I wanted, specific to my needs and household configuration.

The team were great from beginning to end. Good information from sales when I first enquired, neither pushy nor hard to contact as I thought about it. The process to purchase was simple and well supported once I decided to go ahead. The installation went smoothly, the tradies polite and professional (and fast!). I can’t speak highly enough of their team.  There was help with the technology setup and it’s quite simple to use. Thanks, everyone.

The whole process from requesting a quote to installation only took 3 weeks.  Everyone involved was efficient and well-organised and the installer cleaned up afterwards. The quote only took 2 days to finalise and there has been detailed communication every step of the way.  Very impressed with the level of service.

Pricing was perhaps not the cheapest I found but they listened to what was important to me and came up with a good package.Installer also listened to me, and we talked through and agreed an option for routing conduit and placement of the inverter. It's very clean and neat, and ties in well with other services.Plus - needed to update the meter box - I raised a concern over the number of empty slots this would leave me, zero dollar upgrade to a dual-rail unit that gives me plenty of growth space.Compare and contrast to the sales pitch and/or ghosting from others...

The service and communication from this team was top level all the way. My roof is a little challenging due to the design of the house. I had two other providers who couldn’t do what this company could. They personally came out & inspected the property, were honest and clear about what could be done and on the day, despite challenging weather got the job done. My aerial had to be moved, they did a tidier job then the original installer. Cleaned up, showed me through everything and made sure I was happy. A couple of days later they contacted me to make sure everything was okay. I would recommend this Solar provider over any other 100%.Thanks so much RACQ Solar

The whole process with RACQ Solar (GEM Energy) has been professional from start to finish. Any questions we asked along the way were answered and understood. When they came out to do the installation, Michael the head installer answered our questions and explained how it all worked.We installed 16 Qcell Q.MAXX-G4 4.10 watt Solar panels with Sungrow 5kw hybrid inverter with Sungrow lithium battery 9.6kwh of storage. Michael set the system so that if a power outage occurred the kitchen and lights received power from the battery. We also have an app to monitor on our phones to monitor usage and performance. Since installation we have even been generating power on full cloudy days. The battery is always fully charged before 11.30am. Even with running ducted air-conditioning during the day we still have enough power excess to go out to the grid.We are yet to have our meter upgraded and look forward to finally receiving credits and have the system fully up and running. Time will tell whether the ROI will be 8.8 years as they estimate. we are confident it will be sooner than this.We would highly recommend and have already done so with our neighbour who were installed before us!
Very happy with the GEM experience. A few programming issues with the sungrow inverter which was attended to promptly and efficiently.

From contacting RACQ Solar to speaking with their consultant Ed (thank you!) it was such an easy and assisted process all the way through to completed install. We had our own installation manager who organised everything and was quick to respond to any queries we had (Thank you Annalee!). Installation was quick and the install team were punctual and great with communication. Customer service by all parties has been timely, efficient and very appreciated.

This is the second time we have purchased solare through Gem Energy.  Once more, from our initial contact with Kristian regarding the quotation and set-up, to continued communication with Sophie confirming dates and details, the process has gone completely without a hitch.   This system is a much bigger one than the 6.6kw we installed on our last property as we will be running ducted air conditioning and a pool filter.  Installation has been done on time and with no mess and we can't wait to get our first 'bill' from Ergon.Thank you again Gem Energy and Kristian.  Can't recommend this product and your company highly enough.
Communication and customer service was kept up right from the beginning and installation professional. We highly recommend Gem Energy.

After researching the market, to instal our solar panel system, I chose Gem Energy based on product and price.I was assigned an installation manager who did a great job of keeping me updated on the whole process up to and after completion of the job.The installers arrived on time and were polite, experienced and cleaned the site afterwards. At completion of the job I was given a helpful and informative briefing of the system operation by the supervising installer.I am happy to say the system is functioning well and I have no hesitation in recommending Gem EnergyMatt.

The sales/quoting process was professional.The installation time line was brought forward which was excellent.The installation team was punctual, unfortunately one worker smoked outside our bedroom window during their break time which wasn't appreciated.The installation was completed towards the end of the day, so it wasn't until the following day that we discovered that our PV installation wasn't working correctly. With error codes being displayed on the hybrid inverter.I immediately contacted the company to inform them of the situation.We were requested to perform a couple of resets on the PV system, which didn't rectify the defect.It wasn't until a firmware upgrade was performed on our hybrid inverter, 17 days after our system was installed that we finally had a functioning PV system.A few days after that, our electricity provider replaced our electricity meter, with a new digital meter as part of the new PV system install. We are now experiencing erroneous indications on our iSolarCloud APP, which shows us our power usage. Which I find very frustrating.
Thanks for a good jod. Very happy with the service and product

Good and positive experience with GEM, particularly to Sophie who had project managed the entire process and Mike for being so professional and meticulous in the installation. Definitely recommend these guys.

Unlike another company we had quote for us Gem energy promptly provided the quote and then left us alone to make our choice. The other company had a salesman ringing almost hourly offering us more than the last time which resulted in us giving him the flick. In short there was no high pressure sales from Gem Energy, they provided the quote and let the documentation do the talking,Michael from Swann Solar and Electrical was on site for the pre installation inspection a few minutes early and was pleasant to deal with as we agreed for the placement of the panels and the inverter. Swann installer team of Terry and his apprentice arrived on site at the agreed time and date and were very friendly, polite and professional. There was no rubbish left on site and there was no disruption to any of the items stored in the attic or around the house.Initial Sales and quotation was carried out by Jeremy and on acceptance of the quote the project was managed by Sophie who is a real Gem. Our friends had an installation managed by Sophie and they could not speak highly enough of her and referred us to her.An absolute pleasure to do business with the Gem Energy Team and their contractor Swann Solar and Electrical. Energy retailer has yet to do their bit.
Quote was quick and easy, all both parties quoted on same products, all connected to grid and the app up and running :)

The quotation process was professional and Kristian answered all of my questions with factual and relevant information, no sale puffery or embellishment which is what I like. Kristian responded to my inquiries and followed up every time in a timely manner. The online (Google Earth ) quote was backed up with a site visit.Darby managed the installation process and kept me informed every step of the way. The installation was for a rental property and communication was required with tenants, property manager and myself; I found the communication to be exceptional. COVID and weather meant a couple of postponements which could not be helped, but I was informed quickly of any changes.I have not yet seen the install and am looking forward to grid connection so I can start monitoring performance with the online IsolarCloud app from Sungrow.

From the beginning I found dealing with Gem Energy was exceptional and at no point did we feel that we were pressured to purchase a system or a hard sell.  The consultant who we talked to was knowledgeable of the products and really understood our home dynamics. He recommended a system that would suit our needs.From the informative initial quote, onsite inspections, communication via email and phone calls we felt more and more confident  that we picked the right company to install our solar package.When the day came for the installation of our solar system, inverter and battery the team were very professional, helped with any questions we had  and aided us with how to understand our usage via the app. It was the small little touches that made the service so great. From little things like tidying up, trouble shooting with the wifi dongle as well as keeping us informed of what's getting done all added up to a great experience.Would highly recommend  Gem Energy as all I have is high praise for the service I got provided.

It's our 1st solar installation and with what's out there there is a fair bit of risk to end up with the wrong crowd.Not in our case from the product advertising to the completion of the project everything went incredibly smooth. Jeremy our sale consultant was great, not only his knowledge but very confidence inspiring presenting us a seamless project. From that point Marina took over in scheduling the work while navigating outbreaks of Covid19. The installation team was fantastic , very friendly, the workmanship was clean and efficient. At all times we knew there was someone to answer any query we had.From the 1st contact until the final connection we were kept abreast with what was happening and the timing of all the various stages was accurate. I do highly recommend Gem Energy

We had both solar and batteries installed other than some hold ups due to the weather which was out of their control, the system was installed, commissioned and working in a very realistic timeframe. I would highly recommend them on our experience with GEM Energy.

The entire process was very professional from the initial quote to the site inspection and then the installation. The installers, Zack and Gary were fantastic. They explained the process then how to utilise the app to monitor the system, in addition they cleaned up the site prior to leaving.

Having our system installed has caused a leak in our roof which has resulted in a damaged ceiling. This issue was raised with Gem and they sent a plumber out without permission or consultation to inspect the roof and tried to say the fault was ours not theirs, then proceeded to send a bill for the inspection. The plumber never entered the house to see the internal damage so I fail to understand how the plumber was able to qualify the report he provided to Gem. Never had a one on one meeting at any stage with a salesman, all communication were via email or phone, The whole deal seemed shonky!!

Sales and quoting process was excellent was given a lot of information on the products used and the amount it was going to cost to install and savings I would make.The installation team were great arrived on time and were helpful with questions and getting it started they tidied everything up before leaving.Project Manager was also helpful and contacted me with every step I had to go through phone calls and emails.

Kristian was absolutely fantastic from sales. Extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Some of the best customer service I've had, the same can be said for Sophie, after being handed over from sales Sophie did an absolutely amazing job keeping me informed and up to date.Jason the installer was also absolutely fantastic, work was incredibly professional and tidy.10/10 in all aspects. Not a fault through the whole process.

We needed a Solar system replacement, since our existing 10 years old system became faulty with panels moisture ingress.Approached few companies, including GEM Energy found through the RACQ magazine. From the very start they proved to be very customer focused and responsive to our questions, and once we received competitive quote, our decision to go with them seemed to be an easy one.From the first contact with Andrew (Sales), to Project Manager (Sophie) and finally the installation (Ashley), GEM Energy more than lived to our expectations. There are many companies in the market today that boast about Quality and Customer focus. In my personal experience, very few actually deliver on their promises. I have led Quality and Operational Excellence for many years in a large national organisation, so I know a little bit about this area...GEM Energy excelled at every step.Sophie is one of the best project managers I have met in my career, being frequently in touch via email or phone, so we new exactly what and when is planned.Ashley with his crew delivered nothing less than perfection, from dismantling the old system to the installation of the new one.If you are considering a Solar system, make yourself a favour and talk to GEM Energy!

Very happy with Gem Energy for installing our solar from the consultant, manager and team. The communication with everyone was very reassuring. I would recommend Gem Energy to anyone to have the best solar installed. Thank you so much. (Happy Customer!)

The installation of our new solar panels was flawless and expedient from sales through to the installation.Communication for the process was clear. It all happened quickly despite being in the end of year silly season.

The quoting process was excellent - the Rep, who came to see us explained everything in detail. (Other quotes received were phone quotes) We appreciated the personal contact.The installation was seamless - the guys were very professional and kept us in the loop.Gem energy has excellent customer service and kept us well informed  along the whole process.  Highly recommended
Everything from the sales process to the installation was quick and easy. All my questions were answered in detail. Overall, I am really happy with the experience.

Delivered on time. Sales and quoting process was professional, efficient and informative.Installation was as smooth as might be expected.Customer service was excellent.Panels, inverter and battery are working well.
Sales and installation went smoothly. System working well since instal.

Great service from GemEnergy. They gave me all the information I needed to make an informed decision on which quote to go with. They were really respectful through the whole process. GemEnergy have provided a great quality system for a very competitive price.The system was installed by Smart Energy Choices (organised by GemEnergy). I can't recommend these guys highly enough. They were professional, informative and very helpful in getting me set up on the day of install.Overall a great experience all round.

Really happy with the service and professionalism from GEM on my 5kW solar installation. Garret Hay was really knowledgeable and willing provide a range of options that suited our situation. He listened and gave us credible options without being pushy like other solar salespeople. The installation was on time and went smoothly, despite a few challenges which were uncovered with my existing electrical work. Michael Edgar communicated as all of the challenges were identified and talked me through options. The solar was installed and my switchboard is now much safer.
Prompt efficient informative service ,kept up to date with all installations

My entire exposure to Gem and their subcontractor was both positive, and impressive.  I was kept well informed and aware, they were quick, and the standard of documentation was most impressive.  The install contractor was well organised and completed the job to a high standard of workmanship & appearance (as a retired sparkie I am well capable of judging).

It pays to do your homework when looking at solar for your home or business. I actually cancelled an order with a very large solar provider that heavily advertisers after looking more closely at their many customer review complaints, which I did not want to become another statistic. I also was looking for a seamless service from start to finish. After a long and through search I finally found an experienced company called GEM SOLAR with great reviews where I was kept well informed by Chris Roulston in Sales of the choices and finally settled on a quality Canadian Solar Inc Panels and Sungrow Inverter that best suited our needs. Chris was excellent and supplied us with a couple of alternative quotes as well as satellite images showing placement of solar panels on the roof. The Installation Manager Sofia Rivera was terrific and kept us updated thru the install process, it was was seamless from start to finish.  Michael, Ian and team doing a perfect professional installation on time.  Michael was always so helpful, patient, professional and showed us  how the smart app worked as well as the inverter. The energy supplier had us up and running operational in 1 day as we already have a smart read meter in place. i would highly recommend GEM ENERGY to anyone looking at SOLAR whether it was residential or commercial.  5 starsThank You ,Frank and Beverely Usai

Garrett supplied an informative quote and came to our house to present the quote.The installation process was smooth and they came when they said they would, the communication was great throughout.We had great customer service all through the process.
Every  one and everything was great from the installer to the sales people and support staff.

The entire process from start to finish was excellent. At each step, the GEM team were professional, knowledgeable, and responsive. The Sales Rep, the Install Manager, and the Installation Team were extremely easy and pleasant to work with. Communication along the way was great as well.The finished product looks great and is working perfectly, without a single hiccup.GEM are also great value. In my case, the offer was so good, I was even encouraged to take it by a (very honest) competitor. I can't recommend them highly enough.

GEM were perfect.dealt with Sophie who was on the ball for every change in date etccommunication was excellent and site crew did a great jobneat and tidyWould recommend getting in touch with sophie and the crewgreat workSimon

From start to finish, these guys were terrific. We spoke to Garrett in sales about our options, which he laid out extremely clearly and with detail. He never gave us the hard sell, but instead provided us with all the information we needed while still giving us what he thought we should do. Once we settled on what we wanted, the installation manager Lachlan was in communication with us, worked around our schedule and organised a terrific team led by Michael to do the install. The installation didn't take too long and the boys did a terrific and very professional job. No mess, no fuss, and everything was checked and double checked before they left to make sure there were no issues. I would recommend GEM to anyone looking for a proper solar company. 10/10, would hire again.

Sales/quoting was a little awkward as the sales person sent me the documents and then went on a month holiday. installation crew was excellent and very tidy and certainly tried to do the job the neatest way. There was a bit of a mix up with the grid connection but was sorted with a couple of phone calls, it hasn't been connected as yet due to the xmas break.

The quoting process was good and I was able to ask questions and give inputs. The installer that GEM used a guy called Jason was excellent to deal with and was pretty pedantic about getting it right, which is a good thing. The project manager Sophie has been and was a pleasure to deal with. They just made it easy and were in contact throughout the process.

Had our whopping 9.2KW system installed two weeks ago.  Very happy with everything.  The installation boys were tremendous.  I couldn't believe how hard they worked in our tropical Darwin heat.  Love the system.  This is the 2nd house we have used GEM to put us onto solar and would definitely recommend them.
